description: Page selector for a paged list. Renders a windowed range, never every page.

pageCount.description: How many pages there are. Required, and guarded at runtime: an ArenaPagination with no page count renders a window over nothing.

ariaLabel.description: Names this navigation landmark. Required, and guarded at runtime: two paginated tables in one dashboard is a routine layout, and a shared constant name leaves them indistinguishable while satisfying the requirement mechanically. A default name would narrow the gap rather than close it: a name the caller omits is still the constant. Say what is being paged: "Deployments", not "Pages".

change.description: A page was chosen; carries the new 1-based page. Never fires for the current page, nor for a page outside 1..pageCount.
